body:
Issue #241 / ADR-0006 GA honesty gate: prove (or falsify with evidence) that Cursor honors `permission: "deny"` from preToolUse for a frozen-rail Write under ADLC_P4_ENFORCEMENT=1 on at least one maintainer platform. Record results in ADR + harness-capability-matrix. Prefer using pinned payload shapes from T64.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Maintainer-run harness under `scripts/cursor-deny-proof/` (or single mjs) documenting steps: fixture repo with rails, enforcement on, attempt Write to rail, observe allow vs deny. Automate what can be automated; remainder is a checked-in runbook + results log template.
2. If deny works: update ADR Unverified→Pinned with platform/version; matrix Cursor deny cell to proven-with-caveats.
3. If deny slips: keep best-effort language; document failure mode; do NOT silently claim enforcement.
4. Optional CI job that is manual/workflow_dispatch only (never flake required checks on headless Cursor).

=== ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA ===
- AC1: Runbook + harness exist and are referenced from docs/integrations/cursor.md Gaps. VERIFY: file paths + docs link.
- AC2: ADR-0006 Live deny proof section updated with dated evidence (pass or fail) and Cursor version. VERIFY: docs review.
- AC3: Matrix Cursor deny cell updated in same PR (#241 rule). VERIFY: matrix diff.
- AC4: No change that sets failClosed:true on preToolUse (still must not brick editor). VERIFY: hooks.json assert.
- AC5: CI rails-guard template unchanged as the unbypassable control (rails).

=== OUT OF SCOPE ===
- Making in-session deny the security boundary.
- Shell write gating.
- cursor.com publish (T69).
=== P1 ===
Deny-proof requires sentinel + unchanged rail hashes + enforcement-off control.

=== P1 ===
T68 before T69. Live proof covers Task spawn rejection + deny-proof hashes.

=== P1 ===
Deny-proof: pristine→deny→unchanged→then off-control mutates; Task canary required.


(Renumbered from T66 → T68 so main's T62/T63 fleet/hollow-test contracts stay intact for rails-guard.)
